svg.font-family: 'Geist Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.title: How one run works
svg.desc: How one run works. 9 components in 1 groups. Connections: Daily schedule to leetcode_card.py (uses: @v1); LeetCode GraphQL to leetcode_card.py (one GraphQL POST); leetcode_card.py to Write the cards (fetch ok); leetcode_card.py to Every card exists? (fetch failed); Every card exists? to Keep the old cards (yes); Every card exists? to Fail the step (no); Write the cards to Your commit step (git add); Your commit step to Your repo (git push).

text.tspan: One GraphQL query per run, no token. A failed fetch keeps the old cards, or
